x: Jack Brown is to be congratulated on once again getting his name inscribed on the trophy as also are Eddie Short and George Davidson on their 2nd and 3rd placings. Freddie Bradnum "produced" a very fine effort and won the handicap with G.
Gill (3.30) in 9th position, won the handicap with G.
With G. Stevens running very well to finish 88th and Dave Hooper 134th, the team can be said to have done very well to finish 13th out of 44 teams who closed in.
G. Stevens won the Junior 880 in 2m. 7.8s. with D.

Our return match with Surrey Walking Club at Tooting Bec was held on 14th August when a field of 41 turned out. We provided the first five men home with Eric Hall, Dave McMullen, Ted Smith, Ray Switzer and G.

We fielded two teams, and our first stage runners were Len Bishop 'A' team, and G. Stevens 'B' Team, who both ran well, on a stage when positions are rather close, finishing 6th and 18th respectively.
